# VK
> VK is a social networking and internet services platform offering messaging, communities, media, developer APIs, and business tools.

VK provides consumer social products alongside developer, advertising, and business resources. Its public documentation spans platform APIs, mini apps, authentication, payments, and community management.

## Main Platform
- [VK Home](https://vk.com/): Main entry point to VK social networking, messaging, media, and community features.
- [VK Video](https://vk.com/video): Video discovery and playback section for user and community media content.
- [VK Music](https://vk.com/music): Music listening area integrated into the VK platform experience.
- [VK Clips](https://vk.com/clips): Short-form vertical video feed for creators and viewers.
- [VK Communities](https://vk.com/groups): Directory and management entry point for groups, publics, and communities.
- [VK Games](https://vk.com/games): Browser and platform games catalog available within VK.
- [VK Mini Apps](https://vk.com/apps): Catalog of apps and mini apps available inside VK.

## Developer Platform
- [VK Developers](https://dev.vk.com/): Central portal for VK platform documentation, APIs, SDKs, and integration guides.
- [API Reference](https://dev.vk.com/reference): Reference documentation for VK API methods, objects, and platform capabilities.
- [Mini Apps](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps): Documentation for building and publishing VK Mini Apps.
- [VK ID](https://dev.vk.com/vkid): Developer documentation for VK ID authentication and identity services.
- [Web API](https://dev.vk.com/api): Overview and usage guidance for VK API integration.
- [SDKs](https://dev.vk.com/sdk): Official SDK documentation and integration resources for supported platforms.

## API Reference
- [API Methods](https://dev.vk.com/method): Method-by-method reference for VK API endpoints and parameters.
- [API Objects](https://dev.vk.com/reference/objects): Data model reference for VK API object types and fields.
- [API Errors](https://dev.vk.com/reference/errors): Error codes and troubleshooting information for VK API requests.
- [Versioning](https://dev.vk.com/reference/versioning): Information about VK API versions and compatibility expectations.
- [Rate Limits](https://dev.vk.com/reference/limits): Platform limits and request restrictions for VK API consumers.

## Authentication and Identity
- [Authorization](https://dev.vk.com/api/access-token/getting-started): Getting started with VK API authorization and access tokens.
- [OAuth](https://dev.vk.com/api/access-token/implicit-flow-user): OAuth flow documentation for user authorization scenarios.
- [Service Token](https://dev.vk.com/api/access-token/service-token): Service token usage for server-side VK API access.
- [Community Token](https://dev.vk.com/api/community-management/getting-started): Community-related API access and token usage guidance.
- [VK ID Overview](https://dev.vk.com/vkid): Overview of VK ID for login and identity integration.
- [Widget Auth](https://dev.vk.com/widgets/auth): Authentication widget documentation for embedding VK login.

## Mini Apps and Widgets
- [Mini Apps Overview](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/overview): Introduction to VK Mini Apps architecture, capabilities, and lifecycle.
- [Getting Started](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/getting-started): First steps for creating and launching a VK Mini App.
- [Bridge API](https://dev.vk.com/bridge): JavaScript bridge documentation for VK client integrations.
- [Design Guidelines](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/design-guidelines): UI and UX recommendations for VK Mini Apps.
- [Publication](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/publication): Requirements and process for publishing a VK Mini App.
- [Widgets](https://dev.vk.com/widgets): Documentation for VK widgets embedded on external websites.

## Community and Social Integrations
- [Community Management](https://dev.vk.com/api/community-management): Guides for managing communities through VK platform tools and APIs.
- [Bots Long Poll API](https://dev.vk.com/api/bots-long-poll/getting-started): Receive community events and bot updates via Long Poll.
- [Callback API](https://dev.vk.com/api/callback/getting-started): Server-side event delivery for communities using Callback API.
- [Messages API](https://dev.vk.com/api/community-messages/getting-started): Build messaging integrations for community conversations and automation.
- [Streaming API](https://dev.vk.com/api/streaming/getting-started): Access VK streaming data for moderation and analytics scenarios.
- [Embedded Posts](https://dev.vk.com/widgets/post): Widget documentation for embedding VK posts on websites.

## Payments and Monetization
- [VK Pay for Developers](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/vk-pay): Payment integration documentation for VK Mini Apps and services.
- [Orders and Payments](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/vk-pay/merchant): Merchant-oriented payment flow and order handling guidance.
- [Donut API](https://dev.vk.com/api/donut/getting-started): Tools and API guidance for VK Donut community monetization.
- [Ads API](https://ads.vk.com/help/tools/api): API documentation for advertising automation and campaign management.
- [Business Tools](https://vk.com/business): VK business entry point for promotion, commerce, and audience engagement.

## SDKs and Tools
- [VK Bridge](https://dev.vk.com/bridge): Cross-platform bridge library for VK Mini Apps client capabilities.
- [VKUI](https://vkcom.github.io/VKUI/): UI component library for building interfaces consistent with VK products.
- [OpenAPI JavaScript SDK](https://dev.vk.com/sdk/javascript): JavaScript SDK resources for VK web integrations.
- [Android SDK](https://dev.vk.com/sdk/android): Android SDK documentation for VK authorization and platform features.
- [iOS SDK](https://dev.vk.com/sdk/ios): iOS SDK documentation for integrating VK into Apple applications.
- [API Console](https://dev.vk.com/api/api-requests): Interactive tools and examples for testing VK API requests.

## Help and Support
- [VK Help](https://vk.com/support): User support center for VK platform questions and account issues.
- [Developers Support](https://dev.vk.com/support): Support resources for developers using VK APIs and platform products.
- [Rules for Developers](https://dev.vk.com/rules): Platform rules and requirements for VK developers and integrations.
- [Mini Apps Moderation](https://dev.vk.com/mini-apps/moderation): Moderation requirements and review criteria for VK Mini Apps.
- [Brand Resources](https://vk.com/brand): VK brand assets and usage guidance for partners and developers.
